Package org.tweetyproject.beliefdynamics.operators

Class RandomKernelContractionOperator

java.lang.Object
org.tweetyproject.beliefdynamics.MultipleBaseContractionOperator<T>
org.tweetyproject.beliefdynamics.kernels.KernelContractionOperator<PlFormula>
org.tweetyproject.beliefdynamics.operators.RandomKernelContractionOperator
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseContractionOperator<PlFormula>
public class RandomKernelContractionOperator extends KernelContractionOperator<PlFormula>
This class implements a simple kernel base contraction for propositional logic with an incision function that randomly selects its incisions.
NOTE: results of this operator are not deterministic and may not be reproduced (however, each result is a valid kernel contraction)

Matthias Thimm
